outcome: maternal complications (anemia, preterm labor, hypertensive disorders, PPROM, PROM, APH, PPH)
cohort: Fifty women with multifetal gestation (>=28 weeks) were enrolled at a tertiary care center in Jorhat, Assam.
finding: Multifetal pregnancies are associated with increased maternal and neonatal morbidity, with a perinatal mortality rate of 8.1% and no maternal mortality observed.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was 62%, most commonly performed for malpresentation.
gest_age: >=28 weeks at enrollment; 58% delivered between 29-36 weeks
